ui.pickSub: Your guide speaks this language, and the demo case is set in that region. The site itself stays English with Hindi or Tamil.
ui.yourTurn: Tap the glowing spot yourself — or press Next and I'll do it.
ui.voiceNote: Voice plays in Hindi for this language
ui.preparing: Setting up your own copy of the case…

steps.welcome: Hi! I'm Nila, your demo walkthrough guide. In five minutes I'll show you how NILAMS runs a land acquisition from start to finish, using a case in {district}. Press Next and I'll do each step for you, or tap the glowing spot yourself.
steps.lang: English always stays on screen. Beside it you can show Hindi or Tamil. Switch it here whenever you like.
steps.services: This is the public portal. Citizens need no login to follow a project, work out their compensation or file a grievance.
steps.chatbot: Meet VANI, the citizen assistant. Tap here and ask a question in your own words.
steps.login: Now the officer's side. I'll sign you in as the Sub-Collector of {district}. It is your own login, with your own copy of the case, so nothing you do here disturbs anyone else.
steps.dashboard: This is the Collector's dashboard. Deadlines set by the Act that are about to be missed show up here in red.
steps.project: Here is your project: a new bridge across the {river} at {town}. It has no land records yet. Let's add them.
steps.docs: Land records arrive as files from the taluk office. Open the Documents tab.
steps.dl-fmb: First, download the field measurement sheet for {village} village. It describes {plots} plots.
steps.up-fmb: Now drop the file you downloaded into the glowing box, or tap the box and choose it. I have already set the record type to FMB sketch.
steps.commit-fmb: NILAMS has read every row and shows exactly what it will do. Press Commit: {plots} plots registered in one step, instead of {plots} entries typed by hand.
steps.dl-patta: Next, the patta extract, which names the owner of each plot. Download it here.
steps.up-patta: Drop the patta file in. Its extents are written in three different units, the way a real extract is, and NILAMS converts them all.
steps.commit-patta: Press Commit, and {owners} landowners are attached to their plots.
steps.map: Every plot is now on the map of {district}, along the bridge alignment and its 500 metre impact zone.
steps.open3d: Tap here to see the same corridor in 3D.
steps.fly3d: This is real terrain with satellite imagery. Press Fly along alignment for a guided fly-through: a decision maker can inspect the crossing without a site visit.
steps.legal: Now the law. Open the Legal tab.
steps.stay: A writ petition against this acquisition has been filed in the {court}. I'll record the court's stay order on the project.
steps.stay-banner: There it is, on the project itself, where everyone working on the file can see it.
steps.blocked: Open compensation. While the stay stands, every payment on this project is blocked. The law is enforced by the software, not by anyone's memory.
steps.census: A land record names only owners. Tenants and labourers who own no land are affected families too, and only a census can find them. I'll run the social impact survey now.
steps.families: There they are, counted beside the owners, each with the resettlement entitlement the Act gives them.
steps.audit-login: Finally, I'm switching you to the central ministry, which watches every district from one place.
steps.audit: Every action here is chained to the one before it. Press Verify the chain. Any backdated edit would break the chain and show up instantly.
steps.finish: That's the tour! Explore freely, or switch roles below with one tap. Tap me any time to restart or change language.
